extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: electric car (compact EV hatchback), approx. 4.4 x 1.9 x 1.5 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.70 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 4 wheels with aero covers are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); charging flap (electric-car_charge_flap) on the left rear fender is a separate object hinged at its front edge (rotate around local Z, about -100 degrees, to open), charging socket below; panoramic glass roof; no grille, no exhaust; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
